Shell(node -e  const fs = require('fs'); const css = fs.readFileSync('frontend/css/style.css', 'utf8'); // Parser simples: conta depth tratando strings/comentários let depth = 0, i = 0; let inStr = null, inComment = false; let minDepth = 0, minPos = 0; while (i < css.length) { const ch = css[i]; if (inComment) { if (ch === '*' && css[i+1] === '/') { inComment = false; i += 2; } else i++; continue; } if (inStr) { if (ch === '\\') i += 2; else { if (ch === inStr) inStr = null; i++; } continue; } if (ch === '/' && css[i+1] === '*') { inComment = true; i += 2; continue; } if (ch === '"' || ch === "'") { inStr = ch; i++; continue; } if (ch === '{') depth++; else if (ch === '}') { depth--; if (depth < minDepth) { minDepth = depth; minPos = i; } } i++; } console.log('Depth final:', depth); console.log('Min depth:', minDepth, 'na posição', minPos); // Se minDepth >= 0, nunca ficou negativo if (minDepth >= 0 && depth === 0) console.log('=> CSS balanceado (sem erro real)'); else console.log('=> Há desbalanceamento real'); )
